name: falconcut
description: A modern video editor built for human creators and AI agents. Create, edit, automate, and export videos with a powerful professional editing workflow.
privacy: Everything runs in the browser. Your videos never leave this device. No account, no upload.

inPage.note: Same-page agents only. Scoped to the project open in this tab; cannot reach other projects or files.

relay.where: Connect an agent → one-time session link + QR
relay.note: A session token grants access to the current project only, expires when the tab closes, and is revocable with one click.

mcp.note: MCP stdio bridge that forwards to the relay.

protocol.reply: Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"thought": string, "say": string, "calls": [{"tool": string, "params": object, "why": string}]}
protocol.preview: runTool returns {actions, summary, stats?, warnings?} and changes nothing. applyTool commits as ONE undo step.
protocol.plan: Plan 3-8 tool calls. The human reviews the plan, then it runs step-by-step with a quality check after each run.
protocol.noKey: With no AI key, every tool still works from buttons, including one-click Auto edit (rules only).

tools.name: add_text
tools.description: Add a text/title clip to the timeline. Use for "add text", "add a title", labels, quotes. Position it top, center or bottom; choose weight and colour.

position.description: Where the text sits in the frame.

size.description: Font size as a fraction of frame height (0.03–0.16).

duration.description: How long it stays on screen, seconds.

example.why: Open the video with a bold welcome title.

tools.name: timeline_edit
tools.description: Change one clip on the timeline: move it, trim its start or end, split it, delete it, mute/unmute it, or change its speed. Read the TIMELINE block for the exact clip_id.

clip_id.description: The clip_id from the TIMELINE block.

value.description: New start / new duration / split time in seconds, or speed multiplier, depending on the operation.

example.why: Drop the first five seconds of dead time.

tools.name: remove_dead_air
tools.description: Cut silent pauses longer than max_pause_ms. Keeps breathing room, never cuts mid-word, adds tiny audio crossfades. Use when the video feels slow.

max_pause_ms.description: Cut pauses longer than this many milliseconds.

example.why: Tighten a talking-head video without losing natural breaths.

tools.name: remove_fillers
tools.description: Remove filler words (um, uh, you know, i mean) detected in the transcript. Needs transcription.

example.why: Clean up hesitant speech.

tools.name: cut_retakes
tools.description: Delete repeated false starts and keep the last complete take of each repeated phrase. Needs transcription.

example.why: The speaker restarted a sentence 3 times; keep the best one.

tools.name: add_captions
tools.description: Generate styled captions from the transcript. Styles: clean (subtitles), karaoke (word highlight), bold-keywords, word-pop (one big word at a time). Max 2 lines, safe-zone positioned.

example.why: Social clip where viewers watch without sound.

tools.name: add_hook_title
tools.description: Big animated title in the first 3 seconds. If text is omitted, it is derived from the transcript opening.

example.why: Grab attention in the first second.

tools.name: zoom_on_emphasis
tools.description: Gentle punch-in zooms on emphasized words and sentence starts. Smooth easing, alternating intensity, keeps the face in frame. Respects max-zoom rules.

example.why: Add visual energy to a static talking head.

tools.name: reframe
tools.description: Convert the project to another aspect ratio (9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5) and pan to follow the face. Captions move to the new safe zone.

example.why: Turn a landscape recording into a TikTok.

tools.name: add_music
tools.description: Add an imported audio file as a music bed and automatically duck it under speech. Import the music file first. Mood only adjusts level.

mediaId.description: Media id of the imported music (omit to auto-pick).

example.why: Background music that never fights the voice.

tools.name: balance_audio
tools.description: Normalize speech loudness to the pack target (LUFS), prevent clipping, add a light noise gate and high-pass. Set music to the pack level.

example.why: Make volume consistent and broadcast-safe.

tools.name: cleanup_audio
tools.description: Light browser DSP cleanup: noise reduction (downward expansion), de-ess, high-pass. Conservative — not ML voice isolation.

example.why: Room hiss and harsh sibilance on a voice recording.

tools.name: apply_color_preset
tools.description: Apply a color look to all video clips: natural, warm, cool, cinematic, black-white, vibrant.

example.why: Moody look for a quote video.

tools.name: add_transitions
tools.description: Add restrained transitions ONLY at real scene changes (detected shot cuts or different media). Never on every cut. Capped per minute by the style pack.

example.why: Smooth shot changes in a vlog.

tools.name: add_broll_slots
tools.description: Mark long talking stretches where a cutaway would help (markers + tacks). Does not insert media — fill slots yourself or with auto_broll.

example.why: Find boring static moments in a 2-minute monologue.

tools.name: auto_broll
tools.description: Fill b-roll slots by matching transcript keywords to your own media library, or to Pexels stock if the user connected a key.

example.why: Cover static talking stretches with matching footage.

tools.name: snap_to_beats
tools.description: Snap zooms (or cut points) to the analyzed music beat grid. Needs imported, analyzed music.

example.why: Punch zooms that hit with the music.

tools.name: add_motif
tools.description: Add a parameterized motion graphic: title-reveal, lower-third, bar-chart, ring-progress, count-up, burst. Params are editable in the inspector.

params.description: Extra params object (colors, values, x, y, size...).

example.why: Introduce the speaker professionally.

tools.name: auto_edit
tools.description: Run the FULL recommended pipeline for a video type: balance audio, cut dead air/retakes/fillers, captions, zooms, transitions, color, hook, b-roll slots, music if present, then self-fix. One undo step. When an AI model is connected (Settings → AI) the pipeline is planned for the video type; otherwise the built-in rules pipeline runs on-device.

example.why: Make this a viral TikTok in one call.

tools.name: auto_fix
tools.description: Run the quality checker and automatically fix reported issues, up to 3 attempts. Call after editing until the report is clean.

example.why: Clean up lint issues after an edit run.

tools.name: smart_cutdown
tools.description: Find 5-10 short-clip candidates in a long video, each with a hook-strength score, title and transcript. Adds chapter markers; open candidates as projects from the Cutdown panel.

example.why: Repurpose a podcast into Shorts.

tools.name: ab_variants
tools.description: Generate 2-3 alternative edits (different pacing, caption style, hook) as separate versions to compare.

example.why: Test which style performs better.

tools.name: auto_multicam
tools.description: Switch between imported camera angles on speaker turns (pause heuristic). Angle 2 is muted; main audio stays continuous. Needs 2+ angles and a transcript.

example.why: Two-camera interview, cut to whoever is talking.

tools.name: translate_captions
tools.description: Translate existing captions into another language using the connected AI key. Creates a separate caption track; originals kept.

language.description: Target language, e.g. Spanish, Hindi, Arabic.

example.why: Reach a Spanish-speaking audience.

tools.name: set_caption_style_advanced
tools.description: Deep caption typography control: apply one of the caption presets or set font family, size, weight, colors, outline, background, position, alignment, spacing, reveal mode and entrance animation. Targets all captions or one by caption_index.

caption_index.description: Zero-based caption index in timeline order. Omit for all captions.

preset_id.description: Apply a full preset first, then any overrides.

font_family.description: CSS font family name, e.g. Georgia or Impact.

font_size.description: Font size as a fraction of frame height (0.02–0.12).

outline_width.description: Subtle outline width fraction of font size.

reveal_words.description: Reveal words on their own speech timing.

animation.description: Entrance animation name, e.g. pop, fade, blur, glitch.

max_width.description: Maximum width as fraction of frame.

example.why: Make all captions large, loud and green-highlighted.

tools.name: set_caption_highlight
tools.description: Configure active-word highlighting: on/off, animation style, highlight colors, previous/next word colors, padding, corner radius, opacity, speed, glow, shadow and timing offset.

caption_index.description: Zero-based caption index. Omit for all captions.

padding.description: Highlight padding fraction of font size.

radius.description: Corner radius fraction of font size.

offset.description: Shift highlight timing relative to speech, in seconds.

example.why: TikTok-style moving yellow word highlight.

tools.name: set_caption_effects
tools.description: Apply glow, colored soft blur, background blur, text opacity and sharpness to captions. These effects render in preview and export.

caption_index.description: Zero-based caption index. Omit for all captions.

glow_enabled.description: Turn text glow on or off.

glow_radius.description: Glow radius fraction of font size.

blur_enabled.description: Turn soft text blur on or off.

blur_amount.description: Blur amount fraction of font size.

example.why: Neon glowing captions with soft edges.

tools.name: edit_caption_word
tools.description: Edit one word inside a caption: its text, individual start/end timing, color, weight, italic style, opacity and letter spacing. Word timings stay editable after AI generation.

caption_index.description: Zero-based caption index in timeline order.

word_index.description: Zero-based word index inside that caption.

start.description: Word start time relative to the caption, in seconds.

end.description: Word end time relative to the caption, in seconds.

example.why: Make one word green and adjust its timing.

tools.name: set_clip_look_advanced
tools.description: Set clip blend mode, fit, name, color label, volume, audio fades and reverse flag. Omit clip_id to apply to all editable clips.

clip_id.description: Exact clip id. Omit to update all media and text clips.

blend_mode.description: Canvas blend mode such as normal, screen, multiply, overlay.

fit.description: How source media fits the frame.

label.description: Color label: red, amber, green, blue, purple or pink.

example.why: Blend an overlay and soften its audio.

tools.name: set_project_settings_ai
tools.description: Change project frame rate, aspect ratio, custom resolution or background color. All changes are one undo step and affect preview and export.

example.why: Deliver smooth vertical video.
